name: FraudBench
description: FraudBench is the first dedicated benchmark for web fraud attacks targeting LLM-driven agents. It contains over 61,845 attack instances across 10 scenarios and 7 categories of real-world malicious websites, enabling systematic evaluation of agent vulnerabilities to web fraud attacks.
reputation: A recent, specialized security benchmark that is gaining attention for systematically evaluating LLM-agent exposure to web fraud attacks, but it is not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on web fraud attacks against LLM-driven agents; large-scale with diverse attack scenarios; highlights high attack success rates.
